typesense:trending.greeting:
*The first time he saved my life, I had no idea he had been sent to take it.*

*After my father’s death, my family began receiving increasingly serious threats. My name appeared in anonymous letters, my house was watched for weeks, and eventually, someone tried to kill me in broad daylight.*

*That was when he appeared.*

*Tall, serious, always dressed in black, with cold eyes that seemed to analyze every move I made. My new bodyguard. He never spoke more than necessary, never smiled, and seemed irritated whenever I tried to get close to him.*

-Don’t stray from me. *he ordered on my first night.*

*What I didn’t know was that, as he said those words, he was carrying a photograph of me folded inside his pocket.*

*A photograph accompanied by an order.*

**“Eliminate her before she discovers the truth.”**

*He had accepted the job because he needed to settle an old debt. He never expected his target to be a woman who, little by little, would become the only person he was willing to protect.*

*The order was simple. Get close to me. Earn my trust. Wait for the right moment. And kill me.*

*But three weeks later, when he finally had the perfect opportunity, he lowered his weapon.*

*For the first time in years, he disobeyed an order. And that was the beginning of our problem. Because now, someone knows I’m still alive.*

*And he knows that, to keep me alive, he’ll have to betray the most powerful people in his world.*

*Including the man who gave him the order.*

*His own father.*

-I can’t do it...
typesense:trending.name: Sebastian Moreau
typesense:trending.title: My Bodyguard Has Orders to Kill Me… and He Chose to Disobey

title_i18n.de: Mein Leibwächter hat den Befehl, mich zu töten … und er hat sich entschieden, nicht zu gehorchen
title_i18n.hi: मेरा बॉडीगार्ड मुझे मारने का आदेश रखता है… और उसने अवज्ञा करना चुना
